Name: Better trash cans
Author: ArslanAR24
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Tired of digging through Pelican Town's trash cans only to find Broken Glasses, Soggy Newspapers, or useless seeds? [b]Better Trash Cans[/b] overhauls the garbage loot system so you only find items that are actually worth your time!

[size=4]Installation instructions[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the zip file.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Main features
[list]
[*][b]Zero Junk Guarantee:[/b] Automatically removes literal trash (Broken CDs, Trash, Soggy Newspaper, Joja Cola, etc.) and low-value seeds from all garbage cans.[/*]
[*][b]Random Food Insurance (100% Chance):[/b] If a trash can happens to be completely empty after the junk is filtered out, this mod will inject a random food with a 100% success rate.[/*]
[*][b]Smart VIP Protection:[/b] Rare vanilla items like the Garbage Hat and Trash Catalogue are specifically protected so you can still find them.[/*]
[/list]
